name: imath.wasm
description: Imath 2D and 3D vector, matrix, and math operations library compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:simd && npm run build:fallback
scripts.build:simd: npm run configure && npm run build:wasm:simd
scripts.build:fallback: npm run configure && npm run build:wasm:fallback
scripts.build:wasm:simd: cd build && emmake make -j2 && cd .. && mkdir -p wasm-build/simd dist/browser-simd && cd wasm-build && em++ -O3 -msimd128 -std=c++14 -fexceptions -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_vec3f_create","_vec3f_delete","_vec3f_dot","_vec3f_cross","_vec3f_length","_vec3f_normalize","_vec3f_get_components","_matrix44f_create","_matrix44f_create_identity","_matrix44f_delete","_matrix44f_multiply","_matrix44f_inverse","_matrix44f_transpose","_matrix44f_translate","_matrix44f_scale","_matrix44f_rotate_x","_matrix44f_rotate_y","_matrix44f_rotate_z","_matrix44f_get_element","_matrix44f_set_element","_quatf_create","_quatf_delete","_quatf_multiply","_quatf_slerp","_quatf_to_matrix44","_quatf_normalize","_quatf_get_components","_box3f_create","_box3f_create_bounds","_box3f_delete","_box3f_extend_by_point","_box3f_extend_by_box","_box3f_intersects","_box3f_is_empty","_box3f_get_center","_box3f_get_size","_color3f_create","_color3f_delete","_color3f_get_components","_color3f_rgb_to_hsv","_color3f_hsv_to_rgb","_rand48_create","_rand48_delete","_rand48_next_float","_rand48_next_double","_degrees_to_radians","_radians_to_degrees","_clamp_float","_lerp_float","_solve_quadratic","_solve_cubic","_imath_has_simd","_imath_benchmark_vector_ops","_imath_benchmark_matrix_ops","_imath_get_performance_info","_imath_bulk_vector_dot","_imath_bulk_matrix_multiply","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8"]' --bind -s INITIAL_MEMORY=16MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=128MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s STACK_SIZE=2MB -s ASSERTIONS=0 --closure 1 -flto -DIMATH_HALF_USE_LOOKUP_TABLE=1 -I../build/config -I../src/Imath ../wasm/wasm_module_simd.cpp ../build/src/Imath/libImath.a -o imath-simd.js && cp imath-simd.* ../dist/browser-simd/
scripts.build:wasm:fallback: cd build && emmake make -j2 && cd .. && mkdir -p wasm-build/fallback dist/browser-fallback && cd wasm-build && em++ -O3 -std=c++14 -fexceptions -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_vec3f_create","_vec3f_delete","_vec3f_dot","_vec3f_cross","_vec3f_length","_vec3f_normalize","_vec3f_get_components","_matrix44f_create","_matrix44f_create_identity","_matrix44f_delete","_matrix44f_multiply","_matrix44f_inverse","_matrix44f_transpose","_matrix44f_translate","_matrix44f_scale","_matrix44f_rotate_x","_matrix44f_rotate_y","_matrix44f_rotate_z","_matrix44f_get_element","_matrix44f_set_element","_quatf_create","_quatf_delete","_quatf_multiply","_quatf_slerp","_quatf_to_matrix44","_quatf_normalize","_quatf_get_components","_box3f_create","_box3f_create_bounds","_box3f_delete","_box3f_extend_by_point","_box3f_extend_by_box","_box3f_intersects","_box3f_is_empty","_box3f_get_center","_box3f_get_size","_color3f_create","_color3f_delete","_color3f_get_components","_color3f_rgb_to_hsv","_color3f_hsv_to_rgb","_rand48_create","_rand48_delete","_rand48_next_float","_rand48_next_double","_degrees_to_radians","_radians_to_degrees","_clamp_float","_lerp_float","_solve_quadratic","_solve_cubic","_imath_has_simd","_imath_benchmark_vector_ops","_imath_benchmark_matrix_ops","_imath_get_performance_info","_imath_bulk_vector_dot","_imath_bulk_matrix_multiply","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8"]' --bind -s INITIAL_MEMORY=16MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=128MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s STACK_SIZE=2MB -s ASSERTIONS=0 --closure 1 -flto -DIMATH_HALF_USE_LOOKUP_TABLE=1 -I../build/config -I../src/Imath ../wasm/wasm_module.cpp ../build/src/Imath/libImath.a -o imath-fallback.js && cp imath-fallback.* ../dist/browser-fallback/
